sentences.text: Lockheed Martin is an American global aerospace , defense , security and advanced technologies company with worldwide interests .	American	United States	aerospace	aerospace manufacturer	defense	Military	security	Information security	advanced technologies	technology
It was formed by the merger of Lockheed Corporation with Martin Marietta in March 1995 .	Lockheed Corporation	Lockheed Corporation	Martin Marietta	Martin Marietta	merger	Horizontal integration
It is headquartered in Bethesda , Maryland , in the Washington , DC , area .	Bethesda	Bethesda, Maryland	Maryland	Maryland
Marillyn Hewson is the current President and Chief Executive Officer .	Marillyn Hewson	Marillyn Hewson
Lockheed Martin is one of the largest companies in the aerospace , defense , security , and technologies industry .	aerospace	aerospace manufacturer	defense	Military	security	Information security
It is the world 's largest defense contractor based on revenue for fiscal year 2014 .	defense	Military	defense contractor	defense contractor

In 2013 , 78 % of Lockheed Martin 's revenues came from military sales ; it topped the list of US federal government contractors and received nearly 10 % of the funds paid out by the Pentagon .	list of US federal government contractors	Top 100 US Federal Contractors	Pentagon	United States Department of Defense

In 2009 US government contracts accounted for $ 38.4 billion -LRB- 85 % -RRB- , foreign government contracts $ 5.8 billion -LRB- 13 % -RRB- , and commercial and other contracts for $ 900 million -LRB- 2 % -RRB- .

Lockheed Martin operates in five business segments : Aeronautics , Information Systems & Global Solutions , Missiles and Fire Control , Rotary and Mission Systems , and Space Systems .	Missiles and Fire Control	Lockheed Martin Missiles & Fire Control	Rotary and Mission Systems	Lockheed Martin Mission Systems and Sensors	Space Systems	Lockheed Martin Space Systems

The company has received the Collier Trophy six times , including in 2001 for being part of developing the X-35 / F-35B LiftFan Propulsion System , and most recently in 2006 for leading the team that developed the F-22 Raptor fighter jet .
